data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 addresses only one gap (unimported functions) and never delivers the required overall prioritized ordering of all six defects. The problem explicitly states 'A plan that simply says "test everything" is worthless; the deliverable is the ordering and its justification,' yet SRC_001 provides a Priority 3 placement for one item with no test 1, test 2, or comparative blast-radius ranking against the other five gaps, leaving a maintainer unable to implement the plan tomorrow morning.
